verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents ingesting errors from Sentry's open-source SDKs, uploading native debug symbols (dSYM for iOS, ELF for NDK, PDB), and minidump support, which together cover native crash capture and symbolication. However, no evidence names the iOS or Android SDKs or shows device, OS, or app-version context on crash events. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android/NDK SDK support docs, documented device/OS/app-version crash context, hands-on or independent corroboration of mobile crash capture.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture native mobile crashes — iOS, Android, NDK — with the device, OS, and app-version context needed to reproduce them

citations.quote: Upload debug symbols for native applications (dSYM, PDB, ELF)
Logs, cold storage, MCP and minidump support
Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.
GlitchTip can use Sentry's open source SDKs to receive error data from your application.
